fields.duties:
We’re hiring a Senior Systems Engineer to help drive architectural clarity across our Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) platform — the edge and cloud software that connects our humanoid robots to operators, customer systems, and the broader fleet.
This role lives at the interfaces: between the robot and the platform, between the platform and customer integrations, and between product intent and engineering execution. You will focus on systems thinking and broad technical judgment — defining the right architectural constraints, drawing clean interfaces, and surfacing the decisions that most shape the solution so the right architecture can emerge underneath.
You’ll work as part of the engineering team, collaborating across disciplines to provide architectural clarity, shape the direction of the RaaS solution, and ensure the most important decisions are made well and made on time. Strong cross-functional communication is central to the role — much of your impact will come from helping others align around a shared understanding of the system.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Define functional and non-functional requirements for the RaaS platform — including its interfaces to the robot, to customer software, and to operator-facing tools.
Specify architectural constraints (latency, availability, security posture, data ownership, failure semantics) without overconstraining the design.
Own the contracts at key system boundaries: robot APIs, integration APIs for external software providers, and the core platform behaviors that customers depend on.
Drive cross-functional decisions to closure — surface the few high-leverage choices, frame the trade-offs clearly, and keep the team moving.
Translate product intent into engineering scope, and engineering reality back into language product and customers can act on.
Go deep where it matters — across data pipelines (data collection, inference, fleet management), the robot-facing API surface, or cross-cutting concerns like security — as the platform evolves and the work demands.
fields.requirements:
Strong modern C++ and object-oriented programming skills, multi-threading and Linux application development is required
A genuine systems-thinking mindset: you reason about emergent behavior, failure modes, and feedback loops, not just components.
Strong understanding of distributed software architecture — edge/cloud topologies, service boundaries, asynchronous communication, consistency and availability trade-offs.
A track record of working effectively across product, engineering, and program management — translating between them and driving alignment.
Exceptional written and verbal communication. You prioritize ruthlessly, write tightly, and know that an unread document is the same as no document.
Comfort defining requirements and interfaces at the right level of abstraction — neither hand-wavy nor over-specified.
We’re open to candidates coming from either a robotics / industrial automation background or a distributed systems / cloud platforms background. Both paths can succeed in this role.
EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field; master’s degree in computer science or equivalent preferred.
8+ years building production software systems, with significant time spent at the architecture / systems level rather than purely in code.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times
Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen
Hearing and speech to communicate
*This is a direct hire.  Please, no outside Agency solicitations.

fields.duties:
【岗位职责】

1.负责大数据生态相关产品的全栈开发，包括数据平台、数据开发工具、数据治理平台、湖仓管理平台、任务调度系统、可视化管理后台等。

2.使用 Golang 或 Python进行后端服务、API 接口、任务调度、元数据管理、数据处理组件及平台能力开发。

3.使用前端技术栈完成产品控制台、管理后台、数据开发界面、监控页面等功能开发。

4.熟练使用 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程工具辅助完成需求拆解、代码生成、代码重构、测试补全、问题排查和文档编写，提升研发效率和交付质量。

5.持续改进研发流程，探索 AI 辅助开发在大数据产品研发中的最佳实践。

【任职要求】

1.本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、数据工程等相关专业优先。

2.熟练掌握 Golang 或 Python，具备扎实的后端开发能力和良好的工程化编码习惯。

3.熟悉常见后端框架，如 FastAPI、Flask、Django、Spring Boot 等至少一种。

4.具备全栈开发能力，熟悉至少一种前端技术栈，如 React、Vue、TypeScript、Next.js 等。

5.能够熟练使用 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程工具进行全栈开发，具备 AI 辅助编码、调试、测试、重构和代码审查经验。

6.熟悉 MySQL、PostgreSQL、Redis、消息队列、RESTful API、权限认证、异步任务等常见服务端开发能力。

7.具备良好的问题分析能力、学习能力、沟通协作能力和结果导向意识。

【加分项】

1.熟悉大数据生态系统者优先，如 Hadoop、Hive、Spark、Flink、Kafka、Presto/Trino、Iceberg、Hudi、Delta Lake、Airflow、DolphinScheduler 等。

2.有数据平台、湖仓一体、数据开发平台、数据治理平台、元数据管理、实时计算平台或任务调度平台开发经验者优先。

3.熟悉大数据系统中的元数据、血缘、权限、资源调度、作业编排、SQL 执行、数据质量、监控告警等模块者优先。

4.有云原生、Kubernetes、Docker、微服务架构经验者优先。

5.有企业级 SaaS、PaaS、数据中台或开发者工具类产品经验者优先。

6.对 AI 辅助研发流程有实践经验，能够沉淀高效开发方法、代码规范和工程模板者优先。"

title: 具身智能应用开发工程师（27届实习）

fields.duties:
星海图，作为具身智能赛道百亿级独角兽，以全栈自研筑牢技术壁垒——从核心模组、机器人本体，到VLA基础模型、EDP开发平台实现全链路自主研发，稳居行业技术前沿。现诚邀优秀的27届同学加入，以专业之力赋能智能机器人研发，与我们并肩，一起开启机器人新时代，共筑具身智能的星辰大海。

1. 协助开发机器人应用，支持机械臂、灵巧手等设备的功能交互与演示；
2. 参与设备通信协议对接与调试，实现串口、网口、WiFi、蓝牙等数据交互与指令下发；
3. 协助完成界面开发、功能联调、数据可视化、日志展示等应用模块开发；
4. 配合算法、嵌入式、硬件团队进行功能验证，编写测试脚本与自动化调试工具；
5. 负责应用端问题排查、bug修复、版本迭代与相关开发文档整理；
6. 参与Demo场景搭建与演示程序开发，支撑产品展示与真机调试。
fields.requirements:
1. 2027届本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、电子信息、自动化等相关专业；
2. 熟悉至少一种开发语言，如Python/C++等，有实际项目或课程设计经验；
3. 了解基本网络通信、串口通信、Socket编程，有上位机或工具开发经验优先；
4. 熟悉linux与 ROS2，有RM RC比赛经验优先; 
5. 具备基本的问题排查能力，逻辑清晰，动手与学习能力强；有RC,RM机器人比赛经验者优先；
6. 工作认真负责，沟通协作良好，可稳定实习3–6个月，有转正意向者优先。

我们提供
1. 一对一导师带教+完善培养体系，开通校招绿色通道，实习表现优秀者可快速转正；
2. 深耕前沿赛道核心项目，携手全球顶尖伙伴，与行业精英并肩成长；
3. 技术驱动型团队，尊重创新与想法，让实习生的每一份努力都能转化为成长动力；
4. 行业领先的实习薪资，用不完的token和算力资源，舒适的工作环境与自由创新的工作氛围。

参与机器人智能体系统研发，构建任务规划、技能调度、记忆管理和异常处理等核心能力。
基于大模型能力实现工具调用、任务拆解、技能编排和多轮任务推理，提升复杂任务执行效果。
建设智能体记忆系统、知识库和任务执行框架，增强系统在动态场景下的适应能力。
设计任务调度、状态管理和异常恢复机制，提升机器人任务执行的稳定性和鲁棒性。
建立智能体能力评测体系，持续优化交互逻辑、执行效率和任务成功率。
与机器人算法、软件和产品团队协作，推动标准化技能库与应用能力落地。

任职要求

硕士及以上学历，计算机、人工智能、机器人、自动化等相关专业。
熟悉 LLM Agent 核心技术，包括 Function Calling、Tool Use、RAG、任务规划、工作流编排等。
具备扎实的 Python 开发能力，熟悉多进程、异步任务、服务化架构等工程实践。
熟悉行为树、状态机、任务规划、调度系统中的至少一种技术路线。
了解机器人系统基本逻辑，熟悉 ROS2 或机器人软硬件交互者优先。
具备较强的落地意识，能够结合真实任务场景优化系统鲁棒性和执行效率。

有机器人智能体、自动驾驶智能体、工业智能体或复杂任务编排系统落地经验。
熟悉多模态大模型、具身智能、机器人技能库或任务规划系统。
具备 C++ 开发能力或高性能系统优化经验。
有 Agent 框架、RAG 系统、工作流引擎、工具调用平台相关项目经验。

fields.duties:
About Us
At Pickle Robot, we're on a mission to automate global supply chains with Physical AI. Our robots work alongside warehouse teams to unload trucks and containers — one of the toughest, most understaffed jobs in logistics — making the work safer, faster, and more efficient for the people doing it.  Loading trucks comes next, followed by the Dill Autonomy Engine: generalized autonomy that will eventually orchestrate robots across entire logistics processes.
We're looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join our autonomy team and build the scalable systems behind task planning and robotic workflows. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering and robotics infrastructure — you'll work closely with robotics engineers to design backend services that power real robotic systems on the warehouse floor, bringing solid engineering practices into an environment where you're not afraid to get close to the hardware.
At Pickle, your code directly impacts how autonomous robots operate in production warehouses, and you'll see the results of your work in the real world.


What You'll Do
Design and build backend services supporting task planning and autonomy
Develop scalable, reliable, and performant systems using Python (and C++ where needed)
Contribute to system architecture and service design within the team
Build and maintain event-driven systems and messaging-based architectures
Collaborate closely with robotics engineers to integrate backend systems with real-world workflows
Improve system performance, reliability, and maintainability across services
Participate in code reviews and technical discussions to elevate engineering standards

What You'll Bring
3-5+ years of experience in backend or distributed systems engineering
Strong programming experience in Python, with solid experience in C++ or another strongly typed language (e.g., Rust, Go, Java)
Strong understanding of software architecture, concurrency, and distributed system design
Experience building or supporting event-driven systems, messaging frameworks (e.g., Kafka, ROS), or service-oriented architectures
Experience developing systems that interface with hardware, robotics, or real-world operational environments is a plus

Pay at Pickle
At Pickle Robot Company, we believe transparency builds trust. The salary range listed here is provided in accordance with Massachusetts law and reflects what we reasonably and in good faith expect to offer for this role. We often consider candidates at different levels of seniority, and final compensation will reflect the level at which a candidate is hired, along with factors like experience and location.
 
Pickle Perks  
Pickle provides best-in-class benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited vacation; paid federal and state holidays; 401(k) contributions of 5% of your salary; company-covered travel expenses; and other perks to make your working life more fun, comfortable, and productive.

fields.duties:
Company Overview
At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Our team consists of individuals with varying levels of experience and backgrounds, from new graduates to domain experts. Relevant industry experience is important, but ultimately less so than your demonstrated abilities and attitude. We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects.
Position Overview
We are looking for a React Native Developer to join our team in building mobile applications for robot control and monitoring. This role focuses on creating robust, real-time mobile interfaces that interact with our robotics systems using advanced web technologies.
Responsibilities
Develop and maintain our React Native mobile applications
Implement real-time communication features using WebSocket and other technologies
Create 3D visualizations and controls using React Three Fiber
Optimize application performance and ensure smooth user experience
Write Unit and Integrations tests
Write and Maintain Documentations
Collaborate with the UI/UX team to implement designs
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
Participate in code reviews and technical discussions
Basic Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
Strong foundation in JavaScript/TypeScript
Experience with React or React Native development
Understanding of mobile app development principles
Knowledge of state management and API integration
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with WebSocket implementations
Knowledge of React Three Fiber or Three.js
Familiarity with ROS or other robotics-related technologies
Experience with real-time data visualization
Understanding of WebRTC.
Knowledge of mobile app performance optimization
Experience with cross-platform development
